ShortDescription.Value: Box, lasso or polygon select an area, keep only the asset types you ticked, bulldoze them in one go.

Publish.LongDescription:
Bulldozer Marquee adds an area-select bulldozer to Cities: Skylines II. Mark out a region with a box, a lasso or a polygon, and everything inside it that matches your chosen asset types is highlighted live as you draw. Release to commit the selection, then bulldoze the lot in one go.
## Three ways to select
- **Marquee** — drag a box. It follows the camera's rotation, so it always lines up with what you see on screen. - **Polygon** — click out corners one at a time and click the first corner again to close the shape. Right click removes the last corner you placed, so a misplaced one costs a click rather than a restart. Needs at least three corners. - **Freeform** — draw a lasso freehand around whatever you want, and the loop closes itself back to the start.
Switch between them with the three buttons on the panel. Polygon and lasso are what you want around a curved shoreline, a roundabout or an irregular block, where a rectangle would either miss part of it or catch things you meant to keep.
## How to use it
1. Click the bulldozer icon in the top-left. The tool takes over the cursor and the panel appears in the bottom-left corner — drag its header to move it. 2. Pick a selection mode and tick the asset categories the selection is allowed to catch. 3. Mark out the area. Everything caught is ringed as you draw, and the count updates with it. 4. **Bulldoze** deletes the selection. **Clear** drops the selection without deleting anything.
Right click backs out one step at a time: it cancels a selection in progress, then clears a committed selection, then leaves the tool.
## Filters
Trees, props, nodes, segments, buildings, surfaces and net lanes can each be included or excluded independently, so you can clear every tree from an area without touching the roads running through it.
## Options
- **Confirm before bulldozing** — ask before deleting, so a mis-drag costs nothing. - **Keep the selection in sync with the filters** — unticking a filter immediately drops that type out of the selection you already made. - **Play bulldoze sound** — a sound effect on the Bulldoze button.
All three are in Options > Mods > Bulldozer Marquee, and mirrored by checkboxes on the panel itself.
## Notes
The selector is a real game tool, not a UI overlay, so it respects your own key bindings, cancels whichever tool was active when you start it, and closes on Escape like every vanilla tool. Selection outlines are drawn as world geometry, so they drape over terrain instead of floating flat above a hillside.
